class.name: HEGoTerrain3DUtil
class.brief_description: Helpers shared by the Terrain3D input, output and instancer paths.
class.description: Terrain3D is an optional addon, so nothing here refers to its types directly: everything goes through [ClassDB], [method Object.call] and [method Object.get], and every entry point degrades to a warning when the addon or a method is missing.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Whether the Terrain3D addon is present in this project.

method.name: get_layer_by_name
method.description: Returns the heightfield layer called [param layer_name], or an empty dictionary.

method.name: get_attr_value
method.description: Value of one of a layer's attributes, or [code]null[/code] when it is missing.

method.name: get_attr_string
method.description: Same as [method get_attr_value], but always returns a stripped string.

method.name: is_valid_region_size
method.description: Whether [param value] is a region size Terrain3D accepts: a power of two between [constant MIN_REGION_SIZE] and [constant MAX_REGION_SIZE].

method.name: approx_equal_vec3
method.description: Component-wise comparison with a tolerance.

method.name: collect_texture_layers
method.description: Collects the hegot3d_texture_layer_N layers, sorted by slot.

method.name: parse_texture_layer_index
method.description: Slot number encoded in a hegot3d_texture_layer_N name, or -1 if there is none.

method.name: validate_texture_layers
method.description: Checks that every texture layer can actually be turned into a Terrain3DTextureAsset. Control maps address textures by slot, so a single unusable layer would shift every other one: validation is all-or-nothing. Returns [code]{ ok, layers, lowest_slot }[/code] on success and [code]{ ok, warning }[/code] on failure.

method.name: load_texture_resource
method.description: Loads a [Texture2D] from [param resource_path], or null if there is none.

method.name: get_texture_image
method.description: The [Image] behind a texture, or null when it cannot be read.

method.name: get_image_signature
method.description: Size and format of an image, used to compare textures against each other.

method.name: image_signature_matches
method.description: Whether two [method get_image_signature] results describe the same layout.

method.name: set_optional_property
method.description: Sets a property only if the object has it, for properties whose availability depends on the installed Terrain3D version.

method.name: build_control_bits_for_pixel
method.description: Builds the Terrain3D control map value for one pixel. Terrain3D blends exactly two textures per pixel, so the two heaviest weight layers become base and overlay and the rest are dropped. Pass -1 for [param pixel_x] and [param pixel_z] to get the value used for pixels outside every weight image.

method.name: encode_control_bits
method.description: Packs base slot, overlay slot, blend and hole flag into a Terrain3D control value.

method.name: fix_heightfield_image_transform
method.description: Rotates a Houdini heightfield image into Terrain3D's orientation. Houdini heightfields are stored rows-along-Z while Terrain3D expects rows-along-X, which is a 90 degree rotation; the import then mirrors along world X, so the result is flipped back here.

method.name: find_node_from_path
method.description: Resolves a Terrain3D node path, relative to [param host] first and to the edited scene root second, so HDAs can address terrains outside the HEGo node.

method.name: get_terrain_assets
method.description: The Terrain3DAssets of a terrain, or null when it has none.

method.name: get_vertex_spacing
method.description: World size of one terrain vertex, defaulting to 1.0 for terrains that do not say.

method.name: get_texture_name
method.description: Name of the texture in [param texture_id]'s slot, or an empty string.

constants.constant: Category this file logs under, shown in the session panel filter.
Prefix of every heightfield layer and attribute HEGo exchanges with Terrain3D.
Layer name prefix of the per-texture weight layers.
Highest texture slot Terrain3D control maps can address.
Optional Terrain3DTextureAsset properties an HDA can drive, keyed by attribute name.
